title: Multiaccuracy as an Error Benchmark for Learning with Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2611.19701v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agnostic learning has a well-developed theory of computational and statistical complexity. For learning with distribution shift, even the choice of an appropriate error benchmark remains challenging. Testable learning with distribution shift (TDS) was introduced to develop computational foundations for this setting: using labeled training data and unlabeled test data, the learner must either produce a predictor with low test error or detect distribution shift. However, standard agnostic TDS guarantees allow a constant-factor amplification of the optimum error even when the training and test distributions coincide. They therefore do not directly recover the guarantee of classical agnostic learning.   We introduce shift multiaccuracy, a stronger error benchmark inspired by multiaccuracy from algorithmic fairness. translated_title: 多准确性作为分布偏移学习中的误差基准
translated_abstract: 不可知学习已经拥有一套成熟的计算与统计复杂性理论。而对于分布偏移下的学习，即使是选择一个合适的误差基准也仍然充满挑战。可测试的分布偏移学习被提出，以为这一设定建立计算基础：学习者利用带标签的训练数据和无标签的测试数据，必须要么产出一个测试误差较低的预测器，要么检测出分布偏移。然而，标准的不可知TDS保证即使在训练分布与测试分布完全一致的情况下，也允许最优误差被常数倍放大，因此它们并不能直接恢复经典不可知学习的保证。我们引入了“偏移多准确性”这一更强的误差基准，其灵感来源于算法公平性领域的多准确性概念。这产生了一种TDS的形式化定义，当不存在分布偏移时，它等价于多准确性。利用最近的一个非平凡归约……（原文摘要截断于此）
tldr: 该论文提出“偏移多准确性”这一更强的误差基准，使得分布偏移下的可测试学习在无偏移情形下等价于多准确性，从而能够直接恢复经典不可知学习的误差保证。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "shift multiaccuracy," a stronger error benchmark for testable learning with distribution shift that becomes equivalent to multiaccuracy when no shift exists, thereby directly recovering the guarantee of classical agnostic learning.
